svg.text: AI-powered customer support ticketing system (Flask, PostgreSQL, scikit-learn, LangChain + FAISS, Celery, Redis, Socket.IO)
Jinja2 pages (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) + Socket.IO client
New ticket: the classifier sets category,
priority and sentiment; saved to PostgreSQL.
Ticket page: RAG finds KB articles; Gemini
can optionally write the reply from them.
Every 60 s: Celery beat triggers the worker,
which flags tickets that passed their SLA.
The worker publishes through Redis; Flask-
SocketIO shows a live toast in the browser.
